name: GrayhatWarfare (open bucket index)
tier_rationale: Small identifiable operator with published terms (A8 community): 'GrayhatWarfare is a small identifiable operator: tier community.' (P138 rationale); 'community - GrayhatWarfare' (P290 cond 5).

reliability.justification: Index of publicly listable cloud buckets and file names as observed at crawl time: entries can be stale, and brand-named buckets are unverified candidates until linked to the organisation (P138 cond 4).

grayhat.plan_hint: business = a company/team GrayhatWarfare plan recorded by legal before it runs under the corporate profile (P138 cond 1)

api.title: GrayhatWarfare API v2 (files and buckets by keyword)

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company/team account on a plan recorded by legal before it runs under corporate.

sanitizer.notes: Bucket and file names only (P290 cond 8, P138 cond 2): files[].url, files[].fullPath, ids and the echoed query are dropped, so no file link or content is ever kept (A7: no object downloads). File names can carry personal data: names with CPF patterns, e-mails or person names are masked by the module before storage (P138 cond 3). Field names from the GrayhatWarfare API v2 reference (buckets.grayhatwarfare.com/docs/api/v2, checked 2026-11-26).

api.notes: Research C0309 terms 'GrayhatWarfare terms' (status verified_needs_key 401). Endpoints /api/v2/files?keywords= and /api/v2/buckets?keywords=; key in 'Authorization: Bearer' only (the API also accepts ?access_token=, never used: the cache stores URLs); 401 without it = NEEDS_KEY (P138 cond 1). Result cap 100 (P138 cond 5). Used by grayhatwarfare.

search_pages.title: GrayhatWarfare files search page files?keywords= (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: GrayhatWarfare: buckets.grayhatwarfare.com/files?keywords= pre-filled only with analyst-typed entities or org_profile brands; bucket and file names only, never file links or downloads (third-party files may hold personal data, LGPD); privacy badge.

search_pages.notes: Research C0651 terms 'Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)'. Manual links only (data/pivot_links/pentest.json), never fetched by V3LUM. The provider is flagged sensitive: a module that ever declares this source needs its own sanitizer schema (A4). Used by pivots_pentest.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G14-2 and p3-G04-1 (P138, P290). flags.sensitive: an index of exposed bucket files (leak data, LGPD; P290 cond 8): the sanitizer keeps bucket and file names only and the HTTP cache never stores these answers (ttl 0, no-store). Free registered users get the web search limits (API v2 reference); the team plan is not recorded yet: no quota block.
